Qview demo library

A small, self-contained folder used for screenshots and for trying the app out.

Open this folder as the tree root and everything below is neutral sample content.

What lives here

Folder Contents
guide/ Three documents: a quick start, a markdown showcase, an architecture note
notes/ Shorter files, including a plain .txt to show non-markdown rendering
assets/ An image, so the fullscreen viewer and zoom controls have something to open

Why it exists

Screenshots of a file viewer are only as good as the files in them. Shooting a

real working folder leaks paths and file names, so this folder stands in for one:

it has enough structure to look real, and nothing in it belongs to anybody.

Open guide/02-markdown-showcase.md for the richest single page — headings for

the outline, a table, code blocks, a diagram, and callouts all on one screen.
